title: US Reportedly Halts Patriot Deliveries to Ukraine; Zelensky Says It Favours Putin
detail: Il Sole 24 ORE reported on Nov 24 that the United States has halted Patriot air-defence deliveries to Ukraine, and that President Zelensky called the move a gain for Vladimir Putin. Based on a single headline-level report; scope, duration and any official US statement are not yet confirmed.
